factGates.textJa: 本文はヨナタンをサウルの子と明記します。
ヨナタンはゲバのペリシテ人守備隊を打ちました。
ヨナタンと武具持ちはペリシテ人の守備隊へ向かい、主が救う力を持つと語ります。
ヨナタンは父の誓いを知らずに蜂蜜を食べ、民は彼の死を免れさせました。
ヨナタンはダビデを自分のように愛しました。
ヨナタンはダビデと契約を結びました。
サウルがダビデ殺害を家臣に命じたとき、ヨナタンはダビデに知らせました。
ヨナタンはサウルにダビデを弁護し、ダビデを呼び戻しました。
ヨナタンは翌日か三日目に父の意向を探り、ダビデに知らせると約束しました。
ヨナタンはダビデの家との契約を結び、主が敵に報いると語りました。
ヨナタンはダビデに愛のゆえに再び誓わせました。
ヨナタンとダビデは別れ、互いに変わらぬ友情を誓いました。
ヨナタンはダビデを励まし、神への信頼を語りました。
ヨナタンとダビデは主の前で契約を結びました。
ペリシテ人との戦いで、ヨナタンはサウルとともに倒れました。

sourceChecks.text: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA1:13はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA1:14はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA1:15はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David said to him, “Your blood be on your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain the LORD’s anointed.’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA1:16はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA1:17はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: After this, David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” The LORD said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:1はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:2はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:3はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:4はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by the LORD, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:5はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:10はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:11はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:13はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:15はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:17はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:30はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA2:31はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:1はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:2はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:5はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:6はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:8はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as the LORD has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:9はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:10はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:12はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:14はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:17はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Now then do it! For the LORD has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:18はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:19はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:20はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:21はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:22はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:26はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:28はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:31はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA3:35はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to David to Hebron, and said to the king, “Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, your enemy, who sought your life! The LORD has avenged my lord the king today of Saul and of his offspring.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA4:8はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, “As the LORD lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA4:9はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David commanded his young men, and they killed them, cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up beside the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth and buried it in Abner’s grave in Hebron.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA4:12はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:1はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:3はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:4はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:6はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:7はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:8はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:9はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD, the God of Armies, was with him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:10はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:11はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:12はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:13はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:17はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David inquired of the LORD, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:19はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “The LORD has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:20はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:21はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: When David inquired of the LORD, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:23はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David did so, as the LORD commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA5:25はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:1はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David arose and went with all the people who were with him from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of the LORD of Armies who sits above the cherubim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:2はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:5はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David was displeased because the LORD had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah to this day.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:8はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David was afraid of the LORD that day; and he said, “How could the LORD’s ark come to me?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:9はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: So David would not move the LORD’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:10はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: King David was told, “The LORD has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:12はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:14はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the LORD’s ark with shouting and with the sound of the trumpet.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:15はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: As the LORD’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window and saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:16はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: They brought in the LORD’s ark, and set it in its place in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:17はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of Armies.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:18はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:20はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Michal, “It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of the LORD, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before the LORD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA6:21はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: “Go and tell my servant David, ‘The LORD says, “Should you build me a house for me to dwell in?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA7:5はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Now therefore tell my servant David this: ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people, over Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA7:8はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA7:17はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, Lord GOD, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA7:18はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, Lord GOD.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA7:20はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Let your name be magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is God over Israel; and the house of your servant David will be established before you.’
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA7:26はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:1はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:2はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David also struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:3はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung the chariot horses, but reserved enough of them for one hundred chariots.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:4はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:5はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:6はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:7はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:8はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA8:9はダビデを名指すか、同節の明示的なダビデへの言及を含む。

sourceChecks.text: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

イスラエルの長老たちはヘブロンでダビデと契約を結び、彼に油を注いでイスラエルの王としました。
ダビデはシオンの要害を攻め取り、自分の町としました。
契約の箱はダビデが張った天幕の中に置かれ、ダビデは焼き尽くす献げ物と和解の献げ物をささげました。

ダビデは全イスラエルを治め、民に公正と正義を行いました。

ダビデはアラム軍を破り、ショバクを討ちました。
ダビデはバト・シェバを妻とし、彼女は男児を産みました。本文は、ダビデのしたことを主が不快に思われたと記します。
ダビデは自分が主に罪を犯したと認め、ナタンは主がその罪を取り去ったと告げました。
ダビデはバト・シェバを慰め、彼女はソロモンを産みました。
ダビデはタマルへの出来事を聞いて激しく怒りました。
アムノンの死後、ダビデはアブサロムに会いたいと思うようになりました。
アブサロムが呼び出されると、ダビデは彼に口づけしました。
アブサロムの反乱の知らせを受け、ダビデは都から逃れるよう家来たちに告げました。
ダビデはオリーブ山の坂を上りながら泣き、頭を覆い、裸足で歩きました。

ダビデはアブサロムの死を聞き、息子を悼みました。

factGates.textJa: ダビデはハダデゼルの家臣から金の盾を取り、ベタハとベロタイから青銅を得ました。
ハマトのトイは、ハダデゼルとの戦いを聞いて息子ヨラムをダビデに遣わし、贈り物を届けました。
ハダデゼルの戦利品は、ダビデが得た品々の一部として挙げられます。
ハダデゼルはユーフラテス川の向こうのシリア人を招集し、ヘラムへ送ったと記されています。
ハダデゼルに仕えていた王たちはイスラエルと和を結び、以後シリア人はアンモン人を助けなくなりました。

factGates.textJa: イシュ・ボシェテはイスラエルの王となり、四十歳で即位して二年間治めました。
アブネルとイシュ・ボシェテの家臣たちはマハナイムからギブオンへ出て行きました。
十二人がイシュ・ボシェテ側から出て、ダビデの家臣十二人と対しました。
イシュ・ボシェテはアブネルに、父サウルのそばめリツパとの関係を問いただしました。
アブネルはその問いに怒り、サウル家への忠誠を訴えました。
ダビデは使者を送り、ミカルをイシュ・ボシェテに返すよう求めました。
イシュ・ボシェテはミカルを夫パルティエルから迎えました。
レカブとバアナは、昼休み中のイシュ・ボシェテの家に入りました。
レカブとバアナはイシュ・ボシェテの首をヘブロンのダビデへ持って行きました。
イシュ・ボシェテの首はヘブロンでアブネルの墓に葬られました。

factGates.textJa: ダビデはサウルとヨナタンのために哀歌を歌います。
ダビデはヨナタンを「兄弟」と呼び、その愛情を語ります。
ヨナタンには足の不自由な息子メフィボシェトがいました。
ダビデはヨナタンのために、サウルの家の者に親切を示そうとします。
ザバはヨナタンに息子がいると告げます。
ダビデはヨナタンとの誓いのゆえに、ヨナタンの子メフィボシェトを助けます。
ダビデはヨナタンの遺骨をサウルの遺骨とともにヤベシュ・ギレアデから運び出します。
サウルとヨナタンの遺骨は、ベニヤミンの地のツェラにあるキシュの墓に葬られます。
